Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the streaming service by concluding Amazon Prime Video from aggregator/current availability results instead of verifying the original platform the series was made for and premiered on. Authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia, Sony/Crackle materials) clearly indicate Crackle (Sony Crackle). The agent conflated where it can be watched now with the service it was adapted for.
